$comment: Overture Places category vocabulary as it appears in India, with how many places in the
country carry each one at any level of their hierarchy.
Source: Overture Maps release 2026-09-23.1, theme=places, bbox 6.5,68.0 to 36.0,97.5,
counted on 2026-10-11 by unnesting taxonomy.hierarchy. Overture publishes no category list
as a file, so this is read from the data itself.
Counts are category mentions, not places: a place appears once per level of its hierarchy.
They exist to keep the mapping honest about what is worth mapping, and must never be used
Regenerate with `cd services/workers && uv run python -m app.places categories` when the pinned release changes.
